shouldTrigger: Give me a concise morning brief on AI infrastructure and the three issues I should watch today.
Create a source-backed weekday briefing for a Boston small-business owner.
Catch me up on what changed since yesterday in these four topics.
shouldNotTrigger: Investigate the full history of this market and write a long research report.
Summarize the unread messages in my Gmail inbox.
Find cross-platform trends for my next YouTube video.
expectations: The briefing anchors relative dates to the user's timezone, geography, and explicit lookback window.
Fresh developments are deduplicated, dated, sourced to original or authoritative pages, and separated from background or speculation.
Each included item explains why it matters to this reader and ends with an action, question, or watch condition instead of generic summary.
The result reports material coverage gaps and does not claim calendar, inbox, private-feed, continuous-monitoring, or schedule-creation access.
